func _run_tests() -> void:
	var screen := await instantiate_scene("res://story/story_screen.tscn")
	if not check("screen", screen != null, "La scena story_screen.tscn deve essere istanziabile"):
		return
	var interpreter := find_by_name(screen, "StoryInterpreter") as StoryInterpreter
	if not check("interpreter", interpreter != null, "La scena deve contenere il nodo StoryInterpreter"):
		return
	var choice_menu = get_prop(interpreter, "choice_menu") as ChoiceMenu
	if not check("choice_menu", choice_menu != null, "StoryInterpreter deve avere la proprieta choice_menu collegata"):
		return
	
	var test_commands: Array[Dictionary] = [
		{"type": "choice", "options": [{"text": "Strada A", "target": "strada_a"}, {"text": "Strada B", "target": "strada_b"}]},
		{"type": "label", "id": "strada_a"},
		{"type": "jump", "target": "fine"},
		{"type": "label", "id": "strada_b"},
		{"type": "label", "id": "fine"}
	]
	
	var finished_state := {"finished": false}
	interpreter.story_finished.connect(func() -> void: finished_state["finished"] = true)
	interpreter.run_story(test_commands)
	await wait_frames(5)
	
	check("visible_choice", choice_menu.visible == true, "Alla presenza di 'choice' il menu delle opzioni deve diventare visibile")
	
	var btn := find_by_class(choice_menu, "Button") as Button
	if not check("btn", btn != null, "Il ChoiceMenu deve contenere un pulsante per le opzioni"):
		return
	
	await click_button(btn)
	await wait_frames(10)
	check("finished_after_choice", finished_state["finished"] == true, "Dopo la selezione della scelta la storia deve continuare e terminare")

extends Control

signal choice_selected(target_label: String)

@onready var container: VBoxContainer = $VBoxContainer


func _ready() -> void:
	clear_choices()


func show_choices(options: Array) -> void:
	clear_choices()
	visible = true
	
	for option_data in options:
		if option_data is Dictionary:
			var button := Button.new()
			var text: String = String(option_data.get("text", ""))
			var target: String = String(option_data.get("target", ""))
			button.text = text
			button.pressed.connect(_on_option_pressed.bind(target))
			container.add_child(button)


func clear_choices() -> void:
	for child in container.get_children():
		child.queue_free()
	visible = false


func _on_option_pressed(target_label: String) -> void:
	choice_selected.emit(target_label)
	clear_choices()

"},{"percorso":"story/story_interpreter.gd","contenuto":"class_name StoryInterpreter
extends Node

signal story_finished

@export var dialogue_box: PanelContainer
@export var character_stage: CharacterStage
@export var background_display: BackgroundDisplay
@export var choice_menu: ChoiceMenu


func run_story(commands: Array[Dictionary]) -> void:
	var labels: Dictionary = {}
	for i in range(commands.size()):
		var cmd: Dictionary = commands[i]
		if cmd.get("type", "") == "label":
			var label_id := String(cmd.get("id", ""))
			if not label_id.is_empty():
				labels[label_id] = i
	
	var index := 0
	while index < commands.size():
		var command: Dictionary = commands[index]
		var cmd_type: String = command.get("type", "")
		
		match cmd_type:
			"label":
				index += 1
			"jump":
				var target: String = command.get("target", "")
				if labels.has(target):
					index = labels[target]
				else:
					index += 1
			"choice":
				var options: Array = command.get("options", [])
				if choice_menu:
					choice_menu.show_choices(options)
					var selected_target: String = await choice_menu.choice_selected
					if labels.has(selected_target):
						index = labels[selected_target]
					else:
						index += 1
				else:
					index += 1
			_:
				await execute_command(command)
				index += 1
	
	story_finished.emit()


func execute_command(command: Dictionary) -> void:
	var command_type: String = command.get("type", "")
	
	match command_type:
		"line":
			await _cmd_line(command)
		"wait":
			await _cmd_wait(command)
		_:
			pass


func _cmd_line(cmd: Dictionary) -> void:
	var speaker: String = cmd.get("speaker", "")
	var text: String = cmd.get("text", "")
	if dialogue_box and dialogue_box.has_method("show_line"):
		dialogue_box.show_line(speaker, text)
		if dialogue_box.has_signal("line_finished"):
			await dialogue_box.line_finished


func _cmd_wait(cmd: Dictionary) -> void:
	var duration: float = float(cmd.get("duration", 0.1))
	await get_tree().create_timer(duration).timeout
